findings.title: Limited direct entries from the centre
findings.observation: 3 of 143 passes starting outside the final third crossed into it successfully (2%). Other passes may be useful circulation; this does not establish poor decisions.
findings.suggestion: Review the supporting moments for a forward passing option, and compare routes through the other channels.
findings.tradeoff: More direct progression can increase turnover exposure; low entry rate alone does not justify forcing a pass.

findings.title: Transitions without a direct entry or shot
findings.observation: 85 of 100 observed transitions had no completed final-third entry or shot within the clipped 10-second window.
findings.suggestion: Review forward support at these transition starts as a tactical hypothesis.
findings.tradeoff: Sending support forward can reduce cover after another turnover; these observations do not establish causality.

findings.title: Buildup losses on the centre
findings.observation: 23 of 115 buildup passes in this channel were lost (20%); total modeled cost 0.404 xT. Median nearest-opponent distance was 6.8 m.
findings.suggestion: Investigate offering a closer passing option on the centre, or varying the buildup route.
findings.tradeoff: Bringing support toward the ball can leave less space occupied further forward.

findings.title: Unsuccessful observed defensive actions
findings.observation: 33 of 132 recognized defensive actions had unsuccessful source outcomes. Other defensive work is outside this sample.
findings.suggestion: Investigate closer cover around these defensive attempts as a tactical hypothesis.
findings.tradeoff: Closer cover can concede space elsewhere; action outcomes alone do not identify an individual error or establish causality.
